defects.description: Contradiction in terms: the text instructs to 'Spend it on ONE bulk read per run... paginated with LIMIT/OFFSET'. A single bulk read (one query) cannot be paginated with LIMIT/OFFSET, as pagination inherently requires multiple queries. This is a minor technical nit in the instructions.
